output_text: {"action":"answer","expression":"","queries":[],"pages":[244,214],"status":"answered","answer":"Treating personal data as property could prompt poor and vulnerable people to sell it, worsening existing inequities; because data could also be exchanged or used as collateral, people might trade away data containing their digital identity.
